Integrated browser analysis

O-GlcNAc Workbench

Predict candidate sites, then compare each result with curated O-GlcNAcAtlas and OGT-PIN evidence—without uploading your sequence.

Current predictorO-GlcNAcPRED-DL 1.0 · human and mousePredictions prioritize experiments; they are not experimental evidence.

Input

Protein sequence

UniProt accessions in FASTA headers enable evidence matching. Other identifiers still receive predictions.

Result layers

One table, distinct evidence

  1. Prediction reports the published model score.
  2. Atlas reports exact accession, species, residue, and position matches.
  3. OGT-PIN reports accession-and-species OGT interaction evidence.

No composite score is calculated.
